nodes.description: Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals, initialized to 18.
uint256 _totalSupply holding the minted supply of the token.
mapping(address => uint) balances tracking token ownership.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed tracking ERC20 allowances.
constructor initializing token metadata and crediting the full supply to msg.sender.
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning the stored allowance.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without any checks.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves balances and decrements allowance.
msg.sender, externally controlled caller used as balance key, allowance owner and allowance spender.
safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer; arithmetic on tainted balances.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer; arithmetic on tainted derived balance.
safeSub(balances[from], tokens) inside transferFrom; debit without allowance check first.
safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) inside transferFrom; allowance decrement that can revert/underflow.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom; credit to recipient.
_totalSupply - balances[address(0)] subtraction in totalSupply, unchecked arithmetic outside SafeMath.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens state write performed by approve without validation.
tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf, used as balances mapping key.
Named return variable balance of balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter of allowance, outer key of allowed.
spender parameter of allowance, inner key of allowed.
Named return variable remaining of allowance.
spender parameter of approve, inner key of allowed.
tokens parameter of approve, value written into allowed.
Named return variable success of approve.
to parameter of transfer, recipient balance key.
tokens parameter of transfer, amount moved.
Named return variable success of transfer.
from parameter of transferFrom, debited balance and allowance owner.
to parameter of transferFrom, credited balance key.
tokens parameter of transferFrom, amount moved.
Named return variable success of transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balances mapping key when the supply is credited in the constructor and when transfer debits the caller.
msg.sender is used as the outer key of the allowed mapping in approve and as the spender key in transferFrom.
External caller msg.sender triggers approve.
External caller msg.sender triggers transfer.
External caller msg.sender triggers transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes balances consumed by safeSub inside transfer.
The allowance owner key used by transferFrom involves msg.sender in a later step and the caller controls the call.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] decremented by safeSub in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowed in the approve state write.
constructor assigns the name state variable.
constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
constructor sets _totalSupply to the initial minted amount.
constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] produces the value returned by totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
balanceOf assigns balances[tokenOwner] to the named return variable balance.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowed lookup in allowance.
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowed lookup in allowance.
allowance assigns the mapping value to the named return variable remaining.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
approve performs the allowed[msg.sender][spender] state write.
spender parameter selects the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value set in approve.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in the approve write.
tokens parameter is stored into allowed by the approve write.
approve sets the named return variable success to true.
transfer calls safeSub when debiting balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd when crediting balances[to].
safeSub result is written back into balances[msg.sender].
safeAdd result is written into balances[to].
to parameter selects the credited account in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of safeSub in transfer.
tokens parameter is the addend of safeAdd in transfer.
to parameter indexes balances for the credit in transfer.
transfer sets the named return variable success to true.
transferFrom calls safeSub when debiting balances[from].
transferFrom calls safeSub when decrementing the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd when crediting balances[to].
safeSub result is written into balances[from].
safeSub result is written back into allowed[from][msg.sender].
safeAdd result is written into balances[to].
from parameter is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
from parameter indexes balances in the transferFrom debit.
to parameter indexes balances in the transferFrom credit.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the balance debit in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the allowance decrement in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the addend of the balance credit in transferFrom.
transferFrom sets the named return variable success to true.
